response.overview: Ninetyeight08 is a social & historical documentary about the intersection of dance, punk, and hip hop. It’s a chronicle of the points of view and opinions of the musicians themselves. The historical plot line follows the evolution of electronic music and Social Technologies such as the MP3, MySpace, BitTorrent, Streaming, and Peer-to-Peer Systems. This also highlights the line of demarcation where conventional wisdom about the music industry begins to break down.
